articles.headline: Kalshi stop list: 3 habits to drop
articles.standfirst: What the bot's own settled bets say it should stop doing. Suggestions only.
body: The Kalshi review sorts the bot's habits into 3 to stop, 1 to pause, 9 to watch and 5 to keep.
Stop: Buying at 90 to 95 cents, 581 bets for -$248.30 after fees (-4.7% per dollar staked).
Stop: XRP bets, 192 bets for -$106.63 after fees (-6.1% per dollar staked).
Stop: Strategy: 15-min favourites, 1,131 bets for -$88.77 after fees.
The rule as written: Do not buy any contract priced 90 to 95 cents. Wins 92.3% but needs 93.2% to break even, and the losses are bigger bets.
What it rests on: The bot's own 1,836 settled buys (feed of 2026-11-04, 41 days, Kalshi fees already inside the dollars).
